title: Editor crashing on MacOS
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible on v4.6.stable.official [89cea1439]
- Not Reproducible on v4.5.stable.official

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - macOS Sequoia (15.7.3) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 Pro (Apple7) - Apple M1 Pro (10 threads) - 32.00 GiB memory
